label: Raid Speed: speed % per level
description: Flat speed% granted per level of the Raid Speed upgrade.

label: Raid Speed: gold tier base cost
description: Cost of the first (level 0) gold-tier purchase.

label: Raid Speed: gold tier cost growth
description: Multiplier applied per level within the gold tier.

label: Raid Speed: gold tier level count
description: How many levels cost gold before switching to Renown.

label: Raid Speed: renown tier base cost
description: Cost of the first Renown-tier level (i.e. level = goldTierMaxLevel).

label: Raid Speed: renown tier cost growth
description: Multiplier applied per level within the Renown tier.

label: Raid Speed: max level
description: Absolute level cap across both tiers combined.

label: Heroic: success penalty
description: Flat percentage points subtracted from every Heroic encounter's success chance.

label: Heroic: loot bonus
description: Flat percentage points added to every Heroic loot roll.

label: Heroic: duration multiplier
description: Multiplies total raid duration at Heroic difficulty.

label: Heroic: reward multiplier
description: Multiplies gold/xp rewards at Heroic difficulty.

label: Mythic: success penalty
description: Flat percentage points subtracted from every Mythic encounter's success chance. Deliberately brutal -- see 0059's design note before softening.

label: Mythic: loot bonus
description: Flat percentage points added to every Mythic loot roll.

label: Mythic: duration multiplier
description: Multiplies total raid duration at Mythic difficulty.

label: Mythic: reward multiplier
description: Multiplies gold/xp rewards at Mythic difficulty.

label: Barracks: base cost
description: Cost of the first (level 0) Barracks upgrade.

label: Barracks: cost growth
description: Multiplier applied per level, before the early-tier discount.

label: Barracks: max level
description: Highest level Barracks can reach.

label: Barracks: success % per level
description: Flat success percentage points granted per level, guild-wide.

label: Treasury: base cost
description: Cost of the first (level 0) Treasury upgrade.

label: Treasury: cost growth
description: Multiplier applied per level, before the early-tier discount.

label: Treasury: max level
description: Highest level Treasury can reach.

label: Treasury: gold % per level
description: Flat gold percentage granted per level, guild-wide. storagePerLevel (gold storage) is a separate, still-hardcoded field -- not included in this pass.

label: Workshop: max level
description: Highest level Workshop can reach.

label: Workshop: durability % per level
description: Flat durability percentage granted per level, guild-wide. No reward effect.

label: Library: base cost
description: Cost of the first (level 0) Library upgrade.

description: Multiplier applied per level, before the early-tier discount.

description: Flat xp percentage granted per level, guild-wide.
